name: Yjs
summary: CRDT library for building collaborative, offline-capable applications with automatic conflict-free merging.
use_cases: Collaborative text and whiteboard editors, offline-first apps that merge edits when reconnected, multiplayer presence via awareness.
tradeoffs: You still choose and run a provider (e.g. y-websocket) and persistence.
Shared data must be modelled as CRDT types.
avoid_if: you only need simple server-to-client notifications.

name: Liveblocks
summary: Managed platform for collaborative features: presence, live cursors, conflict-free storage, comments and notifications.
use_cases: Adding multiplayer editing, presence and comments to React apps without running realtime infrastructure.
tradeoffs: Managed-only dependency for a core product feature.
Usage-based pricing grows with connections and rooms.
avoid_if: you must self-host or keep collaboration data on your own infrastructure.

name: Socket.IO
summary: Event-based bidirectional communication library over WebSockets with fallbacks, rooms and reconnection.
use_cases: Chat, live notifications, dashboards and simple multiplayer features on a Node.js server.
tradeoffs: Transport only: no offline storage or conflict resolution.
Horizontal scaling needs an adapter (e.g. Redis) and sticky sessions.
avoid_if: you need offline edits merged automatically.

name: Ably
summary: Managed realtime messaging platform with pub/sub channels, presence and message history.
use_cases: Large-scale live updates, chat, and presence where you do not want to run WebSocket infrastructure.
tradeoffs: Managed-only; pricing grows with messages and connections.
Messaging layer only, not a document sync engine.
avoid_if: you must self-host or need CRDT-style document merging.

name: ElectricSQL
summary: Open-source sync engine that streams subsets of Postgres data to clients in real time.
use_cases: Local-first or realtime apps backed by Postgres that need partial replication to clients.
tradeoffs: Requires Postgres plus the Electric sync service.
Write-path and conflict handling are left to the application.
avoid_if: your primary database is not Postgres.
